label: conj:alpha-k-categorical-closure
title: Closed-form resummation of the categorical stratum prefactors $\alpha_k$ — geometric vs symmetric q-dilogarithm candidates
html:
Conjecture (closed forms for categorical resummation). At the substrate level, the categorical resummation \mathcal{F}(\hbar_q^2) of the mass tower provides a dimensionless factor. This factor admits exactly one of the following closed forms:

  1. (Geometric) 1/(1-x) = \sum_{k\geq 0} x^k.
  2. (Symmetric q-dilogarithm) 1 - \mathrm{Li}_2^q(-x).

The geometric closure overshoots the calibrated energy scale. The q-dilogarithm closure is the rigorously bounded analog derived from the brane tower. Both forms evaluate to identical significant figures at the substrate level, leaving the exact CAL-3 direction open.
heading: Conjecture
